disclosure: Forecast accuracy on this test was inspected before this alert analysis. This protocol was frozen before computing alert comparisons, not before the original test. No confirmatory alert-superiority claim is permitted.

high_burden.purpose: App high-community-burden trigger, before activity rules.

seasonal_event.purpose: Research-only seasonal exceedance; public probabilities remain gated.

threshold_selection: Fixed existing policy; no tuning on test or development.
comparison: All models on the same complete region-weeks; no missing=negative.

bootstrap.method: moving calendar-week blocks, all regions together

scope: Community high-burden weeks, not individual infection or benefit of WFH.
